name: Reset
comment: RESET vector entry

name: NMI
comment: NMI vector (vblank); skips work if $60!=0 or $06!=0

name: IRQ
comment: IRQ vector (MMC3 scanline IRQ); ack then JMP ($0054)

name: Vectors
comment: NMI/RESET/IRQ

name: ColdBootInit
comment: taken when $0182-0184 != 'USO' signature

name: WarmBootContinue
comment: common path after cold/warm boot

name: CopySramBlock
comment: copy $7D00-$7EFF -> $6480-$657F then JMP MainLoop

name: IrqDefault
comment: default IRQ handler target (initial $0054/$0055)

name: IrqDefaultPtr
comment: .dw $F421 - Reset copies this word to $0054/$0055 (LDA $F422/$F423)

name: SetIrqHandler
comment: A=index -> $56; $0054/$0055 = IrqHandlerTable[A]

name: IrqHandlerTable
comment: ptr16[8] IRQ handlers: F455 F488 F4E5 F54B F5E1 F60E F691 F61A

name: DelayX
comment: busy loop DEX/BPL

name: IrqHandler0
comment: s65: playfield vertical-wrap split: PPUADDR $2000+(scroll_x>>3) (NT0 row 0) + fine X; arms H1 HUD at $BC-$57

name: IrqMsgWindowTop
comment: s65: IRQ handler 2 (irq_mode 1/9): PPUADDR $2800 (NT2 message window) + ApplyChrAlt; arms H3 after $48 lines; precomputes resume addr $5E/$5F

name: IrqMsgWindowEnd
comment: s65: IRQ handler 3 (chain from H2 only): PPUADDR $5E/$5F (NT0 playfield row) + fine X + ApplyChrPlay; arms H0 (wrap) or H1 (HUD)

name: IrqMsgWindowEndHud
comment: s65: H3 tail: arm H1 at $BE-$57

name: NtRowAddrTable
comment: s65: 32 words $2000..$23E0 = NT0 row addresses (hi read at F5A2+Y; lo at F5A1+Y) by IRQ handlers 2 and 4

name: IrqRowStretch
comment: s65: IRQ handler 4 (dead irq_mode 4): PPUADDR NtRowAddrTable[$5A++] every $58+1 lines; $59 rows then falls into F60E

name: IrqOffSound
comment: s65: IRQ handler 5: IRQ off + SoundUpdate; reached only from F5FE (H4 end) and never via SetIrqHandler

name: IrqMenuChrSplit
comment: s65: IRQ handler 7 (irq_mode 6 equipment menu; line 119): CHR R0/R1 <- $5E/$5F; arms H1 HUD at $BC-$57

name: ColdSaveInit
comment: cold boot only: $700E/$700F=0; unconditionally re-inits the current save image $7D00-$7FFF + mirror $6D00 from template 23:BE00 (was ColdInitSub)

name: ReadPads
comment: per-frame gameplay pad read (pads X=1/0): $43 prev $4B new $49 dir $4D act (A/B hold counters $45/$47); was ColdInitSub2

name: BootSaveCheck
comment: every boot: verify/repair save slots 0/1 (primary vs backup; checksum; AMI tag) and current image $7D00 vs mirror $6D00; bank 23 mapped at $A000 (was BootSub)

name: SaveSlot0Reset
comment: slot 0 invalid: $7100/$7400 <- template 23:BE00 + 2 zero pages; $7001=$FF

name: BootCheckSlot1
comment: slot 1 check (same as slot 0; primary-ok path falls into the backup check)

name: SaveSlot1Reset
comment: slot 1 invalid: $7700/$7A00 <- template 23:BE00 + 2 zero pages; $7001=$FF

name: BootSaveRestoreR7
comment: SetR7($7005) and return

name: BootCheckCurrent
comment: compare $7D00-$7FFF with mirror $6D00-$6FFF + AMI tag at $7DFD; mismatch -> CurSaveReset (no checksum)

name: SaveSumSlot
comment: X = page-table index (31:F26D): adds 3 pages into $16 (8-bit) WITHOUT clearing $16 first (seed quirk)

name: SaveSumPages
comment: 6 page bases for SaveSumSlot: 71 74 77 7A 7D 7D

name: SlotCopy
comment: A = pair index: copy 3 pages src->dst from SlotCopyPages 31:F298

name: SlotCopyPages
comment: 6 src/dst page pairs: 71>74 74>71 77>7A 7A>77 7D>7D 7D>7D

name: NewSaveTemplate
comment: 256-byte default $7D00 page (name ------ / inventory FF / gold 0 / xp_next 30 / MP 34 / HP 48 / level 1 / area 0 at x $88 y $78 / AMI tag)

name: SwitchBank16
comment: A=16KB bank n -> SetR7(2n+1) then SetR6(2n) (falls into C418 path); clobbers A

name: SetR6
comment: A=8KB bank for $8000 window; $6E=shadow; $50=6 (also called directly e.g. A=$1A bank 26)

name: SetR7
comment: A=8KB bank for $A000 window; $6F=shadow; $50=7 (verified)

name: SwitchBank16_13
comment: tail-call SwitchBank16(13) -> banks 26/27

name: SubstateHandlerTable
comment: ptr16[40] state-1 handlers indexed by $41 (CAB6 dispatcher; JMP ($0010)); s60: all named; 10 null

name: SubstateBankTable
comment: u8[40] SwitchBank16 n per substate $41 (s60: 3 24-27 30 -> 9; 12/13 -> 7; rest 0)

name: SwitchBank16_6
comment: tail-call SwitchBank16(6) -> banks 12/13 (restores default after n=7 entity calls)

name: sub_state
comment: state-1 substate index (SubstateHandlerTable/SubstateBankTable)

name: FadeSaveZpToWram
comment: copy ZP $0A-$29 -> $6000; banks 26/27 $8C3D(A=4); wait 30 frames; $8C49; bank 16/17; restore (tentative fade)

name: FarCall_C25D
comment: push $6E/$6F; JSR $C25D; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_B14_800E
comment: push $6E/$6F; SwitchBank16(14); JSR 28:$800E; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_EB91
comment: push $6E/$6F; JSR $EB91; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_B26_8E46
comment: A->$10; push $6E/$6F; SetR6($1A); JSR 26:$8E46 with A; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_B26_8CC0
comment: push $6E/$6F; SetR6($1A); JSR 26:$8CC0; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_D354
comment: push $6E/$6F; JSR $D354; JMP RestoreBanks

name: RestoreBanks
comment: PLA->SetR7; PLA->JMP SetR6 (pairs with push $6E;$6F)

name: ObjSpriteDraw
comment: per-frame pass over 32 object slots -> OAM $0204+; order from ObjDrawOrderTable[$07FF&3]; then ObjHideUnusedOam + OrbitSprites

name: ObjSpriteDraw_Next
comment: loop tail (INC $11 / DEC $1B count 32)

name: ObjSpriteDraw_Offscreen
comment: sets $0380;X bit7 (offscreen) and skips

name: ObjHideUnusedOam
comment: Y=$F0 for OAM from $10 to $FF; if $0710 bit7 clears palette bits of obj1's 6 (4 if $0381 b6) sprites at $07EF

name: OrbitSprites
comment: 8 sprites at OAM $E0-$FC around obj1 ($05C1/$05E1): $06C1!=0 burst (tile $29) else $06C0>>3 orbit (sine $81BA)

name: BurstRadius
comment: Y=ray*4(+2 for Y): radius $81FE[$81DE[Y]|$06C1] negated if $81DF[Y] bit7

name: OrbitSineTable
comment: 32 x s8 sine (radius $21) for OrbitSprites

name: BurstDirTable
comment: 8 rays x (Xidx;Xsign;Yidx;Ysign): idx 00/10/20 selects radius row

name: BurstRadiusTable
comment: 3 rows x 16 radii (row0 diagonal 05..60; row1 04..44; row2 zeros) indexed by $06C1

name: ObjDrawMeta
comment: draw obj X metasprite: optional overlay $0580;X first if $0380 b1; $0380 b6 -> Y+3

name: ObjDrawMetaMain
comment: id=$0300;X(+$0360;X unless $0380 b0) -> ObjMetaPtrLo/Hi; frame=($04E0;X>>3)&mask; emits OAM

name: MetaEmitNormal
comment: 4-byte entries dx;dy;attr;tile; dx=$80 ends; X wrap skips entry

name: MetaEmitHFlip
comment: used after FF redirect: X=-dx-8; attr^=$40

name: ObjDrawOrderOfs
comment: 4 x u8 (00 20 40 60) offset into ObjDrawOrderTable

name: ObjDrawOrderTable
comment: 4 x 32 slot permutations (flicker order); 0=04..1F;00; 3=02 01 1F..03 00

name: ObjMetaPtrTableA
comment: ptr16[128] metasprite ids $00-$7F

name: ObjMetaPtrTableB
comment: ptr16[128] metasprite ids $80-$FF (bank 29 $A000 range); id $9A = $0000 (reads zero page; s54 meta_ptr_check.py)

name: obj_active
comment: 32 slots; 0 = slot empty (skipped by ObjSpriteDraw)

name: obj_x_lo
comment: 32 slots ($70-$8F) world X lo

name: obj_x_hi
comment: 32 slots ($90-$AF) world X hi (screen page)

name: obj_y_lo
comment: 32 slots ($B0-$CF) world Y lo (240-row pages)

name: obj_y_hi
comment: 32 slots ($D0-$EF) world Y hi

name: obj_meta_id
comment: metasprite base id

name: obj_tile_ofs
comment: added to every tile number

name: obj_flags2
comment: bit7: palette-cycle select ($1D) - value unused by emitter

name: obj_meta_dir
comment: added to meta id unless $0380 b0

name: obj_flags
comment: b0 no dir add; b1 draw overlay $0580; b2 half-rate flicker; b4 behind BG; b5 tile+$40; b6 sink 3px + hide attr-b2 parts; b7 offscreen (out)

name: obj_overlay_id
comment: metasprite id drawn over obj when $0380 b1

name: obj_anim
comment: frame counter; frame = (v>>3) & meta mask; stepped by each AI handler (1-3x/frame); no global tick

name: obj_screen_x
comment: written by ObjSpriteDraw

name: obj_screen_y
comment: written by ObjSpriteDraw

name: orbit_level
comment: >>3 indexes OrbitTileTable; 0..7 = no orbit

name: orbit_burst_timer
comment: counts down; burst drawn while <$0E

name: obj1_oam_ofs
comment: OAM offset of obj 1's first sprite (for palette flash)

name: obj_draw_rot
comment: DEC each ObjSpriteDraw; &3 picks draw order; parity for half-rate flicker

name: obj1_flash
comment: player status: lo nibble 1 paralysis 2 stone 3 poison 4 transformed; b7 changed form (magic 7) + b5-4 form 0-3; b6 warp exit (s76); also forces obj1 sprites to palette 0

name: SndOpcodeTable
comment: ptr16[16] stream opcode handlers indexed by byte>>4 (see REVERSE.md Sound data format)

name: SndInitChannel
comment: X=chn: $011A/$0120=stream ptr; dur=1; octave=0; regs cleared; $0114=1 (active)

name: SndInitSfxChannel
comment: like SndInitChannel but stream hi += $20 (bank 12 data assembled at $8xxx; played at $Axxx)

name: SndGetMusicHeader
comment: A=music id -> $F5/$F6 = SndMusicTable[id]; Z=1 if null

name: SndChannelTick
comment: X=chn 0-5: dec duration; on 0 read ops until a frame-ending op; envelope/vibrato; write regs per $FC dirty bits

name: SndReadOp
comment: read stream byte -> $F3; JMP (SndOpcodeTable + (byte>>4)*2)

name: SndOpEnd
comment: op $0x/$1x: channel stops; music: $0113=byte&$1F = next music id (chain/loop); sfx: release channel

name: SndOpSweep
comment: op $Cx: next byte = sweep reg; x bit0=1 -> sweep off else on; ends frame

name: SndOpNoteDetune
comment: op $Dx: note + octave-dependent detune ($83DA); noise chn -> DMC drum trigger ($863B)

name: SndOpNoteSweep
comment: op $Bx: sweep(next byte) + note

name: SndOpNote
comment: op $2x: note x (hex-letter pitch) in current octave; ends frame

name: SndOpOctave
comment: op $3x: octave = (x-1)*$10 into $0156

name: SndOpRest
comment: op $4x: hold/rest; x=0 silences channel; else volume=x (no envelope)

name: SndOpDuration
comment: op $50-$6F: note length = SndDurationTable[byte-$50]

name: SndOpLegato
comment: op $7x: change pitch without retrigger (x=7 = tie/no-op); ends frame

name: SndOpVolume
comment: op $8x: base volume x into $0168 low nibble

name: SndOpDuty
comment: op $9x: TRI $0168 hi nibble=x; SQ/NOISE duty=(x&6)<<5 constvol=x bit0 +$20 halt; x bit0=0 clears env flag

name: SndVibratoTick
comment: per-frame vibrato; phase in $0162 low 3 bits; lo-period only; off-by-one index Y=oct*16+e+2

name: SndVibStepTable
comment: 16 bytes: (depth>>1)*4+phase -> offset-table byte index e (0=no offset)

name: SndVibOffsetTable
comment: s16 period offsets; row per octave at $8726+oct*16

name: SndOpFlow
comment: op $Ax: A0 lo hi=jump; A1 n=loop1 start; A2 n=loop2 start; A4=loop1 end; A3/A5+=loop2 end

name: SndOpEnvelope
comment: op $Ex: envelope #x ($015C=x<<4) enable ($0114 bit6)

name: SndOpVibrato
comment: op $Fx: vibrato depth x*8 ($0162); x<8 on; x=8 off; x>8 = wait one frame

name: SndChnTypeTable
comment: u8[6] channel -> APU type 0 1 2 3 1 3 (chn 4=sfx on SQ2 / 5=sfx on noise)

name: SndChnRegTable
comment: u8[6] channel -> $4000 reg offset 0 4 8 C 4 C

name: SndChnMaskTable
comment: u8[6] $4015 mask with channel bit cleared

name: SndPeriodLo
comment: u8[128] period lo indexed octave*16+note; hi at $8838

name: SndEnvTableTonal
comment: u8[16x16] volume envelopes for pulse/tri (bit4=loop/hold)

name: SndEnvTableNoise
comment: u8[16x16] volume envelopes for noise

name: SndDurationTable
comment: u8[32] frames per note for ops $50-$6F

name: SndDmcTable
comment: 4-byte DMC records (freq raw start len) for noise-channel drum triggers; 13 records all point at 31:FA00 len $3E; record 0 unreachable

name: SndVolumeTable
comment: u8[16x16] output vol = max(env+base-15;1) if both >0 else 0 (row base vol; col env vol)

name: SndOctaveTable
comment: octave op $3x reads $842D+x: x=1..8 -> $00-$70; x=0 reads RTS byte $60 (quirk)

name: SndDetuneTable
comment: u8[8] per-octave period lo add for op $Dx notes

name: SndEnvelopeTick
comment: per-frame envelope step: vol = SndVolumeTable[base*16+env]; entry bit4 = end/hold (fade: back up 2 steps)

name: SndChannelOff
comment: clear channel bit in $4015 (keeps DMC bit from $FF); skipped if chn stolen by SFX

name: SndFadeStep
comment: fade step: TRI cut; other active music chn base vol -1

name: SndDrumSelect
comment: op $Dx on music NOISE: x=0 drums off ($FF=0 $4013=0); else $FF=$10|x (arm DMC record x)

name: SndDrumTrigger
comment: noise note: if drum armed ($FF&$0F) restart DMC with SndDmcTable[x]

name: SndDmcSample
comment: the only DMC sample: 993 bytes $FA00-$FDE0 ($4012=$E8 $4013=$3E); drum kit = this sample at different rates

name: SndMusicTable
comment: ptr16[32] music headers for ids $00-$1F (0 = null); header = 1 byte + 4 stream ptrs (SQ1 SQ2 TRI NOISE)

name: SfxPtrTable
comment: ptr16[88] SFX headers for ids $20-$77 (bank 12 mapped at $A000 via R7); header = priority + 2 stream ptrs (SQ2 NOISE)

name: SndInit
comment: silence all: $F0=0 $0111/$0112=$FF $0114-$0119=0 SND_CHN=0; called from Reset 31:F325

name: SndCommand
comment: cmd in $0110: $FF=none; bit7=pause toggle; <$20 music ($80E4); >=$20 SFX ($8094); sets $F0 bit0 busy

name: SndStartSfx
comment: maps R7=bank 12; ptr=$9FC0+id*2 (=12:$A000+(id-$20)*2); first byte=priority vs $0112

name: SndStartMusic
comment: $0111=id&$7F; inits 4 channel streams via $812A

name: SndTick
comment: per-frame playback; returns early if $F0 bit0 (command in progress)

name: PlaySound
comment: A=sound id (Y kept in $010F); music <$20 deduped vs $0102; enqueue to $0103-$0108; 85 callers

name: SoundUpdate
comment: from NMI F4CF / IRQ F611 (+JMP F6DC F76B F77F); maps 24/25; drains 1 queued id -> SndCommand; R7=25; JSR SndTick; restore banks

name: FadeOut
comment: s89 (was Bank26_FadeA): A->$18 = frames-1 per step; $11 0->$40 step $10; 5 PaletteBuild steps then WaitFrame (port: states/death.js fadeOut)

name: FadeIn
comment: s89 (was Bank26_FadeB): A->$18; $11 $40->0 step $F0; 5 PaletteBuild steps then WaitFrame (port: states/death.js fadeIn)

name: HudHpBar
comment: s46: redraw HP bar ($6060-$6070 from player_hp_max/player_hp); was Bank26_8CC0 (called via FarCall_B26_8CC0)

name: MainLoop
comment: wait $09 (NMI flag) then dispatch on state $40 via MainStateTable

name: scroll_shadow0
comment: copied to $07D8 in NMI

name: nmi_busy_flag
comment: if !=0 NMI only sets $07 and returns

name: frame_ready
comment: set by NMI; MainLoop waits on it then clears

name: jmp_trampoline
comment: 4C lo hi - indirect JSR via zero page

name: main_state
comment: index into MainStateTable (reset sets 2)

name: irq_mode
comment: checked in NMI (7/9 special)

name: irq_vector
comment: ptr used by IRQ JMP ($0054)

name: nmi_disable
comment: NMI returns immediately if !=0

name: cur_bank16_x2
comment: R6 shadow = 8KB bank at $8000 (=2n after SwitchBank16)

name: r7_shadow
comment: R7 shadow = 8KB bank at $A000

name: warmboot_sig
comment: 'USO' (55 53 4F) => warm boot

name: scroll_x_irq
comment: used by IRQ split

name: irq_delay
comment: DelayX count for IRQ handler (init 9)

name: snd_queue_count
comment: number of pending ids in snd_queue (max 5; SFX overwrites last slot when full)

name: snd_queue_lock
comment: 1 while PlaySound edits queue; SoundUpdate skips drain

name: snd_cur_music
comment: last requested music id; bit7 = re-issue pending

name: snd_queue
comment: FIFO of sound ids $0103-$0108 (shifted down after each drain)

name: snd_saved_y
comment: PlaySound returns caller Y from here

name: snd_cmd
comment: command byte handed to SndCommand

name: snd_music_id
comment: currently playing music id ($FF none)

name: snd_sfx_priority
comment: priority of playing SFX ($FF none)

name: snd_flags
comment: bit0 busy; bit5 paused; bit6 SFX lockout; bit7 music-start inhibit

name: snd_chn_shadow
comment: $4015 enable mask mirror (SFX sets $0A)

name: chr_r0_play
comment: CHR R0 shadow (play-field set) applied by ApplyChrPlay 31:F883 from IRQ-side code

name: chr_r1_play
comment: CHR R1 shadow (play-field set)

name: chr_r2_play
comment: CHR R2 shadow = sprite tiles $00-$3F; $40/$41 player ($0713)

name: chr_r3_play
comment: CHR R3 shadow = sprite tiles $40-$7F; $41+clamp($0711 1..5)

name: chr_r4_play
comment: CHR R4 shadow = sprite tiles $80-$BF; per-area record (31:E16D)

name: chr_r5_play
comment: CHR R5 shadow = sprite tiles $C0-$FF; per-area record (31:E16D)

name: chr_r0_alt
comment: CHR R0 shadow (2nd set) applied by ApplyChrAlt 31:F64F

name: chr_r1_alt
comment: CHR R1 shadow (2nd set)

name: chr_r2_alt
comment: CHR R2 shadow (2nd set)

name: chr_r3_alt
comment: CHR R3 shadow (2nd set)

name: chr_r4_alt
comment: CHR R4 shadow (2nd set)

name: chr_r5_alt
comment: CHR R5 shadow (2nd set)

name: ApplyChrPlay
comment: write $07F0-$07F5 to MMC3 R0-R5; JSR'd from F779/F785/F7C8

name: PaletteUpload
comment: NMI (31:F40F X=0): skip if $51 b7; PPUMASK=0; $3F00 <- pal_buf $6140-$615F (backdrop forced into every group); PPUADDR $3F00 then $0000

name: ApplyChrAlt
comment: write $58-$5D to MMC3 R0-R5

name: LoadAreaChrRecord
comment: (ptr $10) record: 00 then $07E6 $07E7 R4 R5 + 4-byte spawn entries from slot $0D; FF end FE skip

name: AreaLoadA
comment: $18=1 then AreaLoad

name: AreaLoadB
comment: $18=0 then AreaLoad

name: AreaLoad
comment: SwitchBank16(6); ptr=AreaPtrTable[$6C]; falls into LoadAreaChrRecord

name: AreaSpawnEntry
comment: decode 4-byte spawn entry for slot X then JMP (SpawnHandlerTable[b2&7])

name: SpawnHandlerTable
comment: 5 x ptr16 spawn handlers (entries 5-7 are code bytes)

name: SpawnH4_Item
comment: type=p; p&F0=$40 flag item (WRAM $6480 bit set -> p=$4E)

name: SpawnH0
comment: type=p+$50

name: SpawnH3
comment: type=p+$D0

name: SpawnH1_Indirect
comment: 4-byte rec from banks 4/5 at $80F0+; type $30 or rec[1]

name: SpawnH1_Tail
comment: $23=p; SwitchBank16(7)+JSR 14:80A0; $20!=0 -> obj_active=0; SpawnCommonTail

name: SpawnH1_TypeRec
comment: rec[0]=$FF: ObjInit type rec[1] then JMP SpawnH1_Tail (no y|=$0E/meta/tile add; s42)

name: SpawnH2
comment: type $0D (+bank14 $85BF) or $0E if p bit7

name: ObjInit
comment: init object slot $10 with type $11 (type 1 = no-op)

name: AreaPtrTable
comment: 252 x ptr16 area records indexed by $6C

name: area_id
comment: current area id (AreaPtrTable index)

name: pal_id_spr0
comment: sprite palette 0 id (player body): 0 or $4D when obj1_flash&$0F=2 (30:C05E)

name: pal_id_spr1
comment: sprite palette 1 id (weapon) = clamp(equip_sword;1..5); same value+$41 -> R3 (30:C0D0)

name: pal_id_spr2
comment: sprite sub-palette 2 id (area record byte1); palette ids $07E0-$07E7

name: pal_id_spr3
comment: sprite sub-palette 3 id (area record byte2)

name: pal_ids
comment: 8 palette ids (BG0-3 spr0-3) -> PaletteBuild 26:8C0E

name: pal_nofade_mask
comment: bit i = palette i ignores fade step in PaletteBuild

name: pal_buf
comment: 32-byte palette buffer (WRAM) written by PaletteLoadOne

name: area_entry
comment: entry index into area sub-table 2 (player start position -> $34-$37; emu s39); $FF none; $2x keep position

name: PaletteBuild
comment: $11=0 (no fade) then builds $6140-$615F from ids $07E0-$07E7; 8C10 = entry with A=fade step

name: PaletteLoadOne
comment: A=id (+$B0 sprite): 4 colours from bank 2/3 $A000+(id>>2&1F)*$100+$F0+(id&3)*4

name: AreaSubTable
comment: A=k: SwitchBank16(5); ($10)=header(10:8300[$6C])[k]; Y=0. k0 map/music k1 gfx k2 entries k3 exits k4 screen flags k5 edge links

name: ExitLookup
comment: player 16px cell vs exit list (xc yc area entry)*;FF; sub_state 8 -> load area

name: ObjTypeTable
comment: ptr16 per object type ($AD00 upper half) -> ObjInit records (snd + 4 bitmask groups)

name: AreaByIndexTable
comment: 16 area ids indexed by $0780&15 (s60: debug area cycler: pad-1 A+B held + pad-2 A in play; 30:CBC7; INC $0780)

name: obj_spawn_b2
comment: spawn entry b2&3

name: obj_spawn_param
comment: spawn entry param byte

name: AreaHeaderTable
comment: ptr16 per area ($8400 half) -> 5 (or 6) sub-table ptrs k0-k4(k5)

name: AreaLoadMap
comment: area sub-table 0: PlaySound(music) + $62FC-$62FF + screen grid -> $6300

name: AreaLoadGfx
comment: area sub-table 1: BG palette ids $07E0-$07E2 + $67/$69 + BG CHR R0/R1 then AreaLoadB

name: AreaRestoreVisited
comment: area sub-table 4: screen visited bits $62F0 from WRAM flags $64C0

name: AreaEdgeLink
comment: area sub-table 5 (10 areas): pit/edge link to another area; s116: ported (states/areaenter.js areaEdgeLink)

name: AreaEdgeLinkNoMatch
comment: s116: no k5 match: sub_state 8; SetR6($1A); JMP $8C49 with banks 10/11 still mapped by AreaSubTable -> jumps into bank-10 data (not the 26:8C49 fade-in)

name: AreaEnterCommonTail
comment: s116: AreaEdgeLink k5-match entry into AreaEnterCommon (after AreaLoadMap + slot copies)

name: MarkScreenVisited
comment: set $62F0[y_hi] |= BitMask[x_hi]; sub-table 4 -> set $64C0 flag

name: CameraClampX
comment: clamp camera candidate $34/$35 (pos_x) to 0..$62FC screens

name: pos_x_lo
comment: shared position cursor X lo (was cam_x_lo; emu s39): k2 entry = player start pos -> $34-$37; ObjPosToTemp/TempAddStep scratch; camera candidate in 31:E90A (from $3C-$3F); BG render cursor

name: pos_x_hi
comment: position cursor X hi (screen); see pos_x_lo

name: pos_y_lo
comment: position cursor Y lo; see pos_x_lo

name: pos_y_hi
